title.zh: 部分Bloom Trading用户集体被盗共计95万美元，官方称已着手调查
title.en: 部分Bloom Trading用户集体被盗共计95万美元，官方称已着手调查

current_state.zh: Blooming cross-chain trading automation tool Bloom Trading suffered a batch wallet compromise in which about $954,000 in SOL (9,408 SOL across 49 victims, largest single loss 1,636 SOL) was moved to suspected attacker addresses, prompting the team to open an investigation and temporarily disable some services.
